req.title: Player deletion persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall remove the row from the players table so GET returns 404 afterwards.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that DELETE /players/{squadNumber} must remove the row from the players table so that a subsequent GET returns 404. The endpoint is DELETE /players/squadnumber/{squad_number}. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — delete an existing player and verify 204 then GET returns 404; (2) negative NEG — delete a non-existent player returns 404; (3) STC state transition — create then delete then re-GET confirms persistence; (4) BVA boundary — delete squad_number=1 (lowest in DB) and squad_number=26 (highest in DB); (5) DT decision table — delete already-deleted player returns 404 (idempotency/double-delete). All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient, exact status code assertions, and verify the DB-persistence aspect by re-querying after deletion.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=10 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
expected: Subsequent GET returns HTTP 404 Not Found confirming DB row was removed
trace: R-PLAYER-021: system shall remove the row so GET returns 404 afterwards
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_existing_player_returns_204_and_subsequent_get_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_player_get_by_uuid_also_returns_404
preconditions: Player with squad_number=15 and UUID 692f2ab9-8aec-4001-a008-0ba06d53ba0a exists in the database
actions: Assert GET returns 200 and id matches known UUID
Send GET /players/{uuid} using the retrieved UUID
Assert GET by UUID returns exactly 404
expected: GET by squad_number returns 200 with correct UUID before delete
GET by UUID returns 404 confirming row removed from DB entirely
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row removed from players table; both lookup paths return 404
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_delete_player_get_by_uuid_also_returns_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    get_resp = client.get('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert get_resp.status_code == 200
    player_id = get_resp.json()['id']
    assert player_id == '692f2ab9-8aec-4001-a008-0ba06d53ba0a'
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/15')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    uuid_resp = client.get(f'/players/{player_id}')
    assert uuid_resp.status_code == 404

test_delete_player_get_by_uuid_also_returns_404()

tests.name: test_delete_player_no_longer_in_get_all_list
preconditions: Player with squad_number=7 exists in the database (pre-loaded fixture)
actions: Send GET /players/ and confirm squad_number=7 is present
Assert squad_number=7 is NOT present in the returned list
expected: Before delete: squad_number=7 appears in GET /players/ list
After delete: squad_number=7 does not appear in GET /players/ list
trace: R-PLAYER-021: row removed from players table; collection endpoint reflects deletion
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_delete_player_no_longer_in_get_all_list():
    client = TestClient(app)
    before = client.get('/players/')
    assert before.status_code == 200
    squad_numbers_before = [p['squadNumber'] for p in before.json()]
    assert 7 in squad_numbers_before
    del_resp = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/7')
    assert del_resp.status_code == 204
    after = client.get('/players/')
    assert after.status_code == 200
    squad_numbers_after = [p['squadNumber'] for p in after.json()]
    assert 7 not in squad_numbers_after

test_delete_player_no_longer_in_get_all_list()
